data.title: Use the Claude Agent SDK with your Claude plan | Claude Help Center
data.summary: CRITICAL PRIMARY SOURCE / POLICY REVERSAL: Official Anthropic Help Center article showing the June 15, 2026 metering change (reported by InfoWorld as separating programmatic from subscription usage) was PAUSED on its own effective date. Verbatim: 'Update June 15, 2026: We've paused the previously-announced changes to Claude Agent SDK usage. For now, nothing has changed: Claude Agent SDK, claude -p, and third-party app usage still draw from your subscription limits.' A later update dated October 7, 2026 shows Anthropic instead added supplementary monthly API credits to Max and Team plans covering the Agent SDK, claude -p, the Claude API, and Claude Managed Agents, while explicitly preserving the prior arrangement: 'You can still use the Claude Agent SDK, claude -p, and third-party apps with your subscription limits.' This means as of the fetch date (Oct 12, 2026), programmatic/agentic usage of Claude via subscription credentials (including third-party apps) is NOT banned and still draws from subscription limits; the credit pool is additive headroom, not a replacement metering scheme. This directly updates/complicates the InfoWorld (May 14, 2026) and sesamedisk reports, which described the metering separation as settled/enforced.

`claude -p`
, and third-party apps with your subscription limits.
